At the Centre for Statistics in Medicine, Dr Paula Dhiman investigates how medical research is done, focusing on the methodological conduct and reporting of non-randomised research, with a view to helping improve the quality and integrity of future research. This is known as meta-research or “research on research”. Paula is passionate about statistical methodology and observational research and is particularly interested in prediction modelling.
